notes.title: Redout: Space Assault adds RTX and DLSS support!
notes.content:
[b]Redout: Space Assault[/b] enhances your space shooting with NVIDIA DLSS and ray traced shadows and reflections for a faster and more immersive experience.

Activating NVIDIA DLSS boosts performances, enabling all GeForce RTX Series graphics cards to play at a super smooth framerate, perfect for the game’s high-speed action. Ray traced shadows and reflections bring all the architectural elements to life. Softer and more detailed shadows on the hulls of fighter and boss ships, including the player's ship, make them more realistic and the added reflections from the surrounding environment really make them stand out.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33035461/452394993096e0b63184fa938c1c44164b6c2164.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33035461/1fece013895c65f29db9ee61da8dea653f141852.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33035461/49abb2f8496ee5fbaf695c2e85ab7a43bedcfdd1.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Nvidia DLSS support for sizzling fast 4K or raytraced 1080p battles.
[*] Ray traced illumination, shadows and reflections for gleaming space environments with natural lights and colors.
[*] Better tuning of graphic quality settings.
[*] Minor QoL fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Redout: Space Assault 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thanks for playing Redout: Space Assault! 

Some of you reported bugs with some missions and achievements, which should all be fixed now:

[list]
[*] The Perfectionist and Completionist achievements now unlock as soon as the relevant objectives are completed
[*] Progress for the Farmer achievement is now correctly saved
[*] FIXED: Mission objectives did not scroll correctly in the mission selection screen
[*] Resolved more hardlock issues in 0905, the missions should flow more smoothly now
[*] Resolved some railgun issues in 0401, never look into the guns.
[*] Resolved some lighting issues in 0107
[/list]

Hope you'll enjoy the game even more!

notes.title: Redout: Space Assault 1.0.1 - The HDR fix Edition®
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thanks for playing Redout: Space Assault! It's time to present our first update, here are the notable changes:

[list]
[*]Improved HDR. It can now be disabled too (needs a game restart)
[*]Balancing fixed throughout all game, sensibly reduced difficulty spikes
[*]Fixed soft/hardlock problems of mission 0905
[*]Fixed several secondary objectives that were very difficult to achieve (specifically 0603, 0702, 0704, 0801, 0802)
[*]Fixed graphic glitches on Railgun/Tesla shots
[*]Fixed some camera glitches in mission 0301 
[*]Fixed several issues caused by manual fire
[*]Full menu mouse support is finally in place
[/list]

Hope you'll enjoy the game even more!

notes.title: Weekend Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[b]Thanks to the many players that tried Redout: Space Assault at launch! [/b]

Some unexpected issues have arisen and we felt the need to upload a flash weekend patch to fix the most blatant one: [b]the AUTOFIRE option is now disabled by default[/b]. This is intended as an extra accessibility option, not as the default way to play the game.

Also, [b]we are currently investigating HDR and other minor and major issues that you flagged[/b]. No QA team, no matter how awesome and dedicated, can hold a candle to you, the hive mind, when it comes to spotting problems.

We'd like to take this chance to remind that other accessibility options, such as inverted controls and sensitivity, are available from the game menu.

On a final note: once again, we realize there are tons of space sims and roguelikes out there. Redout: Space Assault is a different type of game, at a different price point. We currently don't have a demo for you to try and decide if this game is for you, but the second video on the store page is 100% gameplay: that should further help you in taking an informed decision.

Peace
